title: Senior Endpoint Security Automation Engineer
description:
We are HCLTech, one of the world’s largest and fastest growing technology and DSA companies with over 227,000 professionals across 60 countries, driving progress through industry-leading capabilities focused on Digital, Engineering and Cloud.


The driving force behind this work, our people, is a diverse, creative and passionate audience that enables us to continually raise the bar for excellence in our services. We strive to empower each of our professionals to achieve their best, while also striving to help them find their daily inspiration and become the best version of themselves.


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Endpoint Security Automation Engineer to lead the design, development, and optimization of automated workflows for endpoint security event and issue management. This role will be responsible for integrating and automating processes across platforms such as ServiceNow, Microsoft Power BI, Data Hub, SIEM, and SOAR solutions.

The ideal candidate combines deep technical expertise in cybersecurity operations with strong automation, data integration, and process optimization skills. This role plays a critical part in improving detection-to-response time, enhancing operational visibility, and ensuring scalable and resilient endpoint security operations.


Key Responsibilities

Design, implement, and maintain automated workflows for endpoint security event and issue management.

Integrate endpoint detection platforms with ServiceNow for automated ticket creation, enrichment, prioritization, and lifecycle management.

Develop dashboards and executive-level reporting using Microsoft Power BI to provide actionable security insights and KPIs.

Orchestrate data pipelines and security telemetry ingestion Data Hub or equivalent data integration technologies.

Design and optimize SIEM use cases and correlation rules to enhance endpoint threat detection.

Develop and maintain SOAR playbooks to automate triage, containment, remediation, and escalation processes.

Collaborate with SOC, Incident Response, Endpoint Engineering, and IT Operations teams to continuously improve automation and security processes.

Ensure proper documentation of automation workflows, integrations, and operational procedures.

Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing manual effort and increasing response efficiency.

Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior team members.


Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent experience).

5+ years of experience in cybersecurity operations, with strong focus on endpoint security.

Proven experience integrating and automating workflows within ServiceNow.

Hands-on experience building reports and dashboards in Microsoft Power BI.

Experience working with data orchestration platforms such as Data Hub.

Strong experience with SIEM platforms (e.g.,Sentinel).

Hands-on experience with SOAR platforms and playbook development.

Solid understanding of endpoint security tools (EDR/XDR) or BeyondTrust

Experience with scripting and automation (e.g., Python, PowerShell, REST APIs).

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Excellent communication skills and ability to work in cross-functional

Diferenciais:

title: Market Intelligence Manager - Americas
description:
Summary of Job Duties


Ensure their regional team fulfils the roles and responsibilities of:

Customer development

  • Lead opportunity assessment: proactively engage in customer development, leverage marketing intelligence capability to assess customer opportunity, generate customer leads from current or potential opportunities driving from new developed product and formulation.
  • Customer development action plan: proactively engage in action plan formulation, and engage in customer communication and execution
  • Customer solution proposal: coordinate external resources to design customized market service plan based on customer’s need

Customer relationship management

  • Proactively engage in relationship mgmt. with KA’s marketing related departments, gathering market insights to support R&D and BD

Marketing service:

  • Delivery & after-sales: responsible for leveraging internal capability and external resources to deliver marketing service and after-sales


Main Responsibilities


Although the position is a management role the candidate also expected to be hands on and involved wherever required for the regional team to carry out the following responsibilities:


  • Market Research

To visit customer site with sales and also collect market information in their region such as:

  • Customer Survey Analysis
  • Customer service needs/opportunities
  • Customer’s org chart
  • Customer’s end consumer insights and trends
  • Prospects and opportunity analysis
  • Category Analysis
  • Sales Channels
  • Competitive landscape


  • Marketing Support Service

Help promote, drive and expand our added value service to our customers to provide them with our 360 marketing solution

  • Market Research/Business Intelligence
  • Receipe support
  • `zSales distribution


  • Account Based Marketing

Will be responsible to perform research to find high-value accounts to target as well as spend time developing growth strategies from their findings. They will ensure marketing activities line up with strategies developed and ultimately translate plans to the sales team for execution. They need to ensure the follow steps are covered:

  • Identify high-value target accounts – Identify key accounts that have the potential to contribute the most to the revenue of your company.
  • Conduct research on those accounts - Get a good snapshot of customer needs and pain points, as well as where they are in their customer journey.
  • Develop customized marketing campaigns - Using information you learned in the research phase to inform your strategy, develop creative assets that will resonate with the target account.
  • Run customized marketing campaigns - Launch your campaigns to the target account.
  • Measure customized marketing campaigns - Analyze the data to see how your campaigns are performing.


  • Online Marketing

Will be in charge of creating localized content regularly update the following marketing channels in their assigned region.

  • Webinars
  • SEO – Quarterly updates on the regional assigned webpage
  • Social media – Weekly updates on social media platforms in where they are based – language will depend on where they are based
  • Email marketing – Monthly articles that can be distributed for sales use in their regions.


  • Offline Marketing

Will handle the planning and implementation of offline marketing tasks in the assigned region which could cover

  • Exhibitions
  • Roadshows
  • Print (Quarterly updates)
  • PowerPoint presentations (Company introductions, products or service introductions)


  • Public Relations
  • Build up media relations and ‘Distribution Media List’ for future press release distribution in their assigned region.
  • Ensure appearance on at least one reputable news website in their assigned region.


Qualifications (Education/Knowledge/Working Experience)


  • Master’s degree in a Marketing related discipline.
  • Around 10 years of experience
  • Knowledgable in hands on B2B2C marketing as well as the consumer market in the beverage industry.


Skills Needed


Market Research and Analysis: The ability to conduct thorough market research, analyze data, and draw actionable insights is crucial for understanding the target market, consumer behavior, and industry trends.

Strategic Planning: Regional Marketing Managers must be adept at developing and executing marketing strategies that align with overall business objectives. This includes setting clear goals, defining KPIs, and creating actionable plans.

Team Leadership and Management: Effective leadership skills are important for managing and motivating a team of marketing professionals. This includes providing guidance, setting expectations, and facilitating collaboration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Regional Marketing Managers need to work closely with various departments like sales, product development, and supply chain to ensure that marketing initiatives are aligned with overall business operations.

Brand Management: They should have the ability to maintain and enhance the brand image in the specified region. This involves ensuring consistency in messaging, visual identity, and customer experience.

Campaign Management: This skill involves planning, executing, and optimizing marketing campaigns. It requires the ability to set clear objectives, target the right audience, and measure the effectiveness of campaigns.

Budget Management: Effective allocation and management of marketing budgets are essential for maximizing return on investment (ROI) and ensuring that resources are used efficiently.

Data Analysis and Interpretation: Proficiency in using data analytics tools to measure campaign performance, track key metrics, and derive actionable insights is crucial for making informed marketing decisions.

Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary for conveying marketing messages effectively to various stakeholders, including team members, executives, and external partners.

Adaptability and Flexibility: The ability to adapt to changing market conditions, consumer preferences, and industry trends is vital for staying competitive and achieving long-term success.

Problem-Solving Skills: Regional Marketing Managers should be able to identify challenges and develop creative solutions to overcome them. This includes being resourceful and thinking critically.

Cultural Awareness and Sensitivity: Especially in a regional role, understanding and respecting cultural nuances and preferences is important for tailoring marketing strategies to specific markets.

Time Management: Effectively prioritizing tasks and managing time to meet deadlines is essential in a fast-paced marketing environment.

Tech-Savviness: Familiarity with marketing technology tools and platforms, as well as proficiency in relevant software and applications, is important for executing marketing initiatives efficiently.

Negotiation Skills: The ability to negotiate and build partnerships with external stakeholders, such as agencies, vendors, and media outlets, can be crucial for successful marketing campaigns.

title: Senior Network Security Engineer
description:
The Network Security Engineer is responsible for protecting an organization’s networks and data from cyber threats. This role involves designing, implementing, and maintaining security infrastructure (firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, VPNs, etc.) and monitoring the network for vulnerabilities or incidents. The engineer will play a critical role in upholding Zero Trust security principles and ensuring high availability and integrity of network services in a dynamic, cloud-enabled environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Security Infrastructure Management: Configure, deploy, and maintain network security systems (firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPN gateways, encryption devices) to safeguard internal networks and cloud environments.
  • Threat Monitoring & Incident Response: Monitor network traffic and logs for suspicious activities; promptly investigate and respond to security incidents or breaches to minimize impact.
  • Vulnerability Assessment: Conduct regular security audits, vulnerability scans, and penetration tests to identify and remediate network weaknesses. Implement patches and updates to address vulnerabilities and ensure systems are protected against emerging threats.
  • Access Control & Policies: Enforce access controls and network segmentation (supporting a Zero Trust Network Access model) by administering firewalls and network access control lists. Develop and update network security policies, standards, and procedures to align with best practices and compliance requirements.
  • Collaboration & Advisory: Work closely with IT infrastructure teams, application developers, and security architects to integrate security measures into new projects and systems. Provide guidance on secure network design and educate team members on security best practices.
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain detailed documentation of configurations, incidents, and changes. Ensure all network security measures comply with relevant regulations and industry standards (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS) and assist in preparing for security audits.

Required Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or related field (or equivalent work experience).
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of networking protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, VPN, etc.) and hands-on experience with network security technologies (firewalls such as Palo Alto/Cisco/Fortinet, IDS/IPS, VPN solutions, SIEM tools). Proficiency in configuring and managing firewalls and routing/switching equipment in complex networks.
  • Security Expertise: Knowledge of cybersecurity principles , threat landscape, and best practices (e.g., Zero Trust architecture, defense-in-depth, encryption, secure network design ). Ability to perform log analysis, intrusion detection, malware analysis basics, and incident handling.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills for diagnosing network and security issues. Ability to respond effectively under pressure during security incidents or outages.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, explain technical issues to non-technical stakeholders, and provide user training or guidance on security policies when needed.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Advanced/Cloud Security: Experience with cloud security (AWS, Azure, or GCP networking and security services) or secure network design in hybrid cloud environments . Familiarity with SASE (Secure Access Service Edge) frameworks or software-defined networking is a plus.
  • Automation & Scripting: Scripting or automation skills (e.g., Python, PowerShell) to automate network/security tasks and improve efficiency in security operations.
  • Advanced Education: Master’s degree in Cybersecurity or Information Systems.

Experience Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum 5+ years of hands-on experience in network security, cybersecurity engineering, or a related IT infrastructure security role. Proven track record implementing and managing firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs, and performing security monitoring and incident response in an enterprise or managed services environment.

Certifications:

  • Industry Certifications: Professional certifications are highly advantageous . Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM (for security management knowledge) or CEH, GIAC (for technical security skills). Vendor-specific certifications such as Palo Alto Networks PCNSE/PCNSA are also valuable and demonstrate expertise in relevant technologies.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Security Engineer to own and scale security across a fast-growing cloud-native platform. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with practical, real-world security experience.

You will be responsible for securing infrastructure, applications, CI/CD pipelines, and third-party integrations — while enabling engineering teams to move quickly and safely.


Responsibilities

  • Secure AWS infrastructure including IAM, RDS, networking, secrets management, and Terraform-managed resources
  • Strengthen security across serverless backends, APIs, and cloud services
  • Improve application security across web and mobile applications
  • Embed security into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
  • Own logging, monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes
  • Conduct third-party vendor security reviews (e.g., payments, identity, infrastructure tools)
  • Support compliance readiness (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR) and assist with customer security reviews
  • Act as the internal security point of contact during growth and audits


Must Have

  • Strong engineering fundamentals (cloud, Linux, networking, APIs)
  • Hands-on AWS security experience
  • Deep understanding of web and API security (authentication, permissions, OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience handling production security incidents
  • Automation mindset (Python, scripting, infrastructure-as-code awareness)
  • Ability to balance risk pragmatically in a fast-moving startup environment
  • Fluent spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Experience securing serverless architectures
  • Exposure to payments, identity verification, or distributed systems
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 frameworks


Role Details

  • Fully remote B2B
  • Contract role (12 months)
  • CET working hours
  • 300 USD per day

title: ESPECIALISTA SISTEMAS [SAP SUCCESS FACTORS]
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra. Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 132 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos.


Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.


Buscamos profissional para atuar na gestão funcional e governança do ecossistema SAP de RH, com foco em SAP SuccessFactors (lado cliente, sem acesso a provisioning), SAP HCM migrando para SAP S/4, garantindo sustentação, evolução e alinhamento estratégico das soluções.


Responsabilidades e Requisitos Técnicos:

1. Gestão Funcional do SuccessFactors


  • Atuar como ponto focal interno da TI da solução SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Administrar configurações funcionais permitidas no ambiente produtivo (sem acesso a provisioning – essa responsabilidade é da consultoria AMS).
  • Organizar e priorizar demandas evolutivas junto ao RH.
  • Especificar requisitos com foco em melhorias ou novas demandas para atendimento via consultoria externa.
  • Escrever especificações funcionais para desenvolvimentos específicos ou integrações.
  • Validar entregas e realizar testes funcionais (UAT).
  • Conhecer, monitorar e direcionar ações nas integrações com sistemas satélites.
  • Entender processo de negócio e solução técnica para direcionar ações evolutivas nos APPs Fiori desenvolvidos em SAP BTP de modo a gerenciar as entregas, melhorias e suporte dado pela consultoria responsável.
  • Diferencial ter conhecimento na navegação do BTP e IAS.
  • Diferencial ter conhecimento em SFSF EC.
  • Acompanhar roadmap, tendências e atualizações SAP.
  • Analisar release notes, atualizações de quarters, avaliar impactos no ambiente, abrir e acompanhar chamados no SAP for Me.
  • Entender e suportar as liberações de Acessos conforme papéis e responsabilidades da governança GP.
  • Módulos SFSF atualmente instalados: EP, LMS, Recruiting, Metas e Desempenho, Carreira e Sucessão.

2. Gestão de Sistemas Satélites


  • Melhorias, sustentação e governança com foco em:
  • Conhecimentos em SAP HCM em PA, OM, PY, BN, TM e eSocial.
  • Apoiar no SAP HCM (suporte Rimini)
  • Participar ativamente no projeto de migração do ECC para S/4Hana (em andamento).
  • Diferencial com conhecimentos no Ronda (controle de ponto), DMS (gestão documental).
  • Monitorar e direcionar de atendimento ao suporte de interfaces e integrações aos sistemas que compõe o landscape de soluções de RH
  • Atuar em chamados específicos e/ou em incidentes críticos.
  • Apoiar e suportar à obrigações legais dentro dos processos de RH, tais como: eSocial, admissões, afastamentos, atualização sindicais, desligamento, movimentações, LGPD, etc.
  • Apoiar demais sistemas integrados ao ecosistema de RH como: SOC, eBox, AD Azure, etc.

3. Gestão de Demandas e Melhoria Contínua


  • Receber, organizar e classificar demandas do negócio.
  • Conduzir análise de impacto funcional e sistêmico.
  • Priorizar backlog em conjunto com stakeholders.
  • Elaborar cronogramas e plano de ação.

title: Marketing Operations Manager (with Marketo)
description:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.


What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.


Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention


If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.


About The Role:

We’re seeking a Marketing Operations Manager to own and evolve our Marketo ecosystem. This role will take full responsibility for the platform, improve how it’s structured and used, and partner closely with our Marketing team and Salesforce Admin to drive scalable, reliable execution. This person will immediately stabilize and improve the system, while enabling others on the team to operate more effectively.

We expect East/West Coast/etc. work hours.


As Our Marketing Operations Manager, You Will:

  • Own day-to-day execution in Marketo (email sends, landing pages, forms, smart campaigns, programs, UTM parameters)
  • Drive Marketo platform architecture, governance, and best practices
  • Improve program structure and operational standards
  • Design and maintain scalable campaign frameworks
  • Optimize lead lifecycle, scoring, routing, and sync with Salesforce
  • Act as the primary Marketo expert and point of escalation
  • Partner with the Salesforce Admin on data model, integrations, and automation
  • Identify gaps, inefficiencies, and technical debt
  • Support and mentor other Marketo users on the team
  • Contribute to longer-term marketing operations strategy and tooling decisions
  • Manage the integrations of additional tools like On24, ZoomInfo and other items in the MarTech stack
  • Maintain database health through smart list logic, segmentation, and deduplication strategies.
  • Track KPIs for campaign performance, conversion rates, and lead funnel progression.
  • Recommend and implement improvements to marketing automation workflows and program efficiency.


You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in a marketing operations or marketing automation role.
  • Proficient in Marketo ; Marketo Certified Expert (MCE) preferred. Hands-on, end-to-end usage as well as administrative support are equally critical. Experience with HubSpot is also preferred.
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce CRM ; admin experience highly desirable.
  • Strong understanding of marketing automation best practices including deliverability, nurture strategies, and lead scoring.
  • Experience with marketing data analysis, segmentation, and reporting.
  • Familiarity with UTM strategy, campaign attribution models, and web analytics tools.
  • Experience with integrations, webhooks, or APIs
  • Strong troubleshooting and systems-thinking skills
  • Ability to thrive in a collaborative, metrics-driven, and fast-paced team environment.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2+/C1 or higher).


What We Offer:

  • Our compensation package includes a competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.
  • Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. You will have regular career conversations with your manager where you will discuss your short and long-term career goals. We are committed to helping you develop in your career and offer the potential for internal mobility opportunities
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, a remote-first work environment, flexible vacation, team events, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you make, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • Personal laptop
  • Health and wellness package


Candidates must have primary residency (and be physically located) in the country of hire (AKA Colombia/Brazil) in order to be considered for the position. If hired, the worker must maintain primary residency in the country of hire in order to be eligible for employment.


We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal-opportunity employer.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:

  • Fluent spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 frameworks


Role Details

  • Fully remote B2B
  • Contract role (12 months)
  • CET working hours
  • 300 USD per day

title: Brand Manager / Brand Development Leader - Casino slots LATAM market
description:
Please note that we are only considering candidates with proven experience in the LATAM market and experience working with Casino Slots products. Please send you CV in English.


Art of Spin is an ambitious iGaming startup within the Altenar ecosystem. We are building the brand from scratch and planning an aggressive international expansion with a portfolio of innovative slot games and unique mechanics.

Our goal is to become a recognized industry player by leveraging creativity and virality — succeeding where competitors rely primarily on massive marketing budgets.


Your Mission

To take the Art of Spin brand from “unknown” to a top-of-mind choice for operators and players, starting with the LATAM market and expanding into Asia and the United States.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Building the brand foundation: Development and implementation of the brand book and corporate website. The website must include a functional Client Hub with technical specifications (RTP, volatility) and marketing assets for partners.
  • Go-To-Market (GTM) strategy: Development and execution of launch plans for specific regions (especially Brazil and Mexico), including localization of game content to align with cultural specifics of the markets.
  • B2B promotion and networking: Active LinkedIn development: lead generation, publishing news about signed contracts and game launches. Working with aggregators and direct outreach to operators. Preparation for participation in key exhibitions (ICE, SiGMA).
  • B2C marketing and virality: Identifying and executing bold and unconventional promotional ideas with viral potential. Building and managing a network of streamers (from micro-influencers to major stars) and affiliates. Managing social media campaigns (TikTok, Instagram Reels) to showcase gameplay and big wins.
  • Creative leadership: Providing deep context, strong hooks, and detailed briefs for the design and animation teams.


Candidate Requirements:


  • Deep expertise in iGaming: Minimum 5–10 years of experience in the industry; strong understanding of the entire ecosystem (provider — aggregator — operator — affiliate — player).
  • Knowledge of the LATAM market: Understanding of regional specifics, popular mechanics, traffic costs, and player preferences in Latin America (proven case studies in this region will be considered a strong advantage).
  • Startup mindset: Willingness to work within limited budgets, focusing on efficient organic growth strategies instead of expensive traditional campaigns.
  • Hands-on approach: At the initial stage, readiness to independently lead key processes (strategy, networking, creative briefs), with gradual team building of 3 specialists (SMM, commercial, design).
  • Creative drive: Ability not just to follow a plan, but to actively push the market and the team forward with bold ideas.


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to build an international brand from scratch within a dynamic startup environment.
  • Work in a distributed international team (Cyprus, Malta).
  • High flexibility in decision-making.
  • Minimal corporate bureaucracy.
  • Real ownership and impact from day one.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Application Security Engineer
description:
We are seeking a remote, full-time Senior Application Security Engineer with 5+ years of experience to help strengthen the security posture of the software platforms. This role will be responsible for reviewing application code, identifying security vulnerabilities, and working closely with development teams to ensure secure coding practices are followed throughout the software development lifecycle.


The ideal candidate will have strong experience in application penetration testing, fraud detection and analysis, and secure software development practices. This individual will play a key role in proactively identifying risks in PHP, Python, and Angular applications, while also educating development teams on secure coding standards and best practices.


Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class property management system integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular security assessments, code reviews, and penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities in applications and software, including manual and automated code reviews for applications written in PHP, Python, and Angular
  • Analyze applications for common vulnerabilities such as those identified in the OWASP Top 10, including risks related to authentication, authorization, data validation, and session management
  • Conduct application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments on web applications and APIs, simulating real-world attack scenarios to uncover security weaknesses and documenting findings with recommended mitigation strategies
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments to proactively identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies
  • Track, analyze, and manage vulnerabilities in applications while providing guidance and support for remediation efforts
  • Analyze application behavior and transaction patterns to detect potential fraud or abuse scenarios and identify vulnerabilities that could enable account takeover, payment fraud, or data manipulation
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to design controls that reduce fraud risk.
  • Work closely with development teams to ensure security best practices are integrated throughout the software development lifecycle (SDLC), including developing secure coding guidelines, delivering secure coding training, and providing guidance during design and architecture reviews
  • Design, develop, and implement security tools, frameworks, and methodologies to protect applications against security threats, including integrating and maintaining security testing tools such as SAST, DAST, and dependency scanning within CI/CD pipelines
  • Assist in investigating, analyzing, and responding to security incidents related to applications, ensuring timely resolution and documentation of incidents
  • Track vulnerabilities and remediation progress through internal ticketing systems while collaborating with engineering, DevOps, and product teams to improve the overall application security posture and assist in developing internal security policies and procedures


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 5+ years of experience in application security, penetration testing, or secure software development
  • Strong understanding of web application security principles and the OWASP Top 10
  • Experience reviewing code in PHP, Python, and modern JavaScript frameworks such as Angular
  • Experience performing application penetration testing and vulnerability assessments
  • Knowledge of authentication, authorization, encryption, and secure session management
  • Experience identifying and mitigating fraud or abuse patterns in applications
  • Familiarity with common security testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Snyk, SonarQube, etc.)
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to explain security issues to non-security engineers


Desired Experience:

  • University degree or relevant industry experience
  • Experience integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with cloud security principles
  • Experience with secure architecture reviews
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, CEH, GWAPT, or CSSLP
  • Experience working in agile development environments


Additional Information:

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
  • Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
  • Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
  • Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
  • Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
  • Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
  • Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
  • Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
  • Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
  • Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
  • Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
  • Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
  • Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
  • Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
  • Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
  • Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
  • Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
  • Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento).
  • Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança).
  • Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados).
  • Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions).
  • Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas).
  • Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos).
  • Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards).
  • Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Integration Analyst
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, transparência, autenticidade, engenhosidade e empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores? Aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Nosso Cliente

Esta vaga atenderá nosso cliente, uma grande multinacional do segmento de petróleo e gás.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Atuar como Integration Analyst , apoiando iniciativas estratégicas de integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento em nuvem.

  • Criar, consumir e manter APIs REST , garantindo segurança, escalabilidade e performance.
  • Implementar e sustentar soluções em Azure , utilizando serviços como Azure Functions, App Services, Storage, Service Bus, Key Vault e Application Insights .
  • Trabalhar com integração de sistemas entre múltiplas plataformas , incluindo ambientes corporativos e parceiros externos.

  • Garantir segurança de APIs , utilizando padrões como OAuth2 e JWT .
  • Produzir e manter documentação técnica clara e estruturada .
  • Colaborar com times técnicos internos, stakeholders de negócio e parceiros externos em um ambiente corporativo global.
  • Atuar em times Agile , participando de cerimônias Scrum e/ou SAFe.


O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência comprovada com Azure Cloud , incluindo:
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Storage
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Certificação AZ-104 – Azure Administrator .
  • Experiência com controle de versão (Git/GitHub) e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência em integração de sistemas e desenvolvimento de APIs REST .
  • Conhecimento em segurança de APIs (OAuth2, JWT).
  • Vivência com testes automatizados (unit e integration tests).
  • Aplicação consistente de Clean Code , Design Patterns e princípios SOLID.
  • Inglês avançado (escrita e conversação).


Será um destaque no seu perfil

  • Experiência com publicação de aplicativos mobile (Apple Store e Google Play).

No conforto da sua casa. A posição é oferecida em regime 100% Home Office , com atuação para um time global e ambiente ágil.

Confira abaixo os detalhes e requisitos mínimos para a sua inscrição:


O que é SAP CCS?

O CCS é a solução da SAP voltada para gestão do ciclo de relacionamento com clientes, muito usada em empresas de Utilities (energia, água, gás, telecom). Ele cobre todo o ciclo de atendimento: do primeiro contato do cliente até faturamento, cobrança e serviços técnicos em campo.


O que é o Bootcamp?

Um programa intensivo de capacitação voltado à formação de consultores SAP.

Requisitos mínimos para participar:

Ter, no mínimo, 3 anos de experiência profissional como:

Analista de negócios com foco em processos de atendimento a cliente em empresas de utilties: cadastro de clientes, faturamento, gestão de ordem de serviço, contas a pagar e a receber.

Analista de TI com experiência em aplicações similares ao SAP CCS no atendimento às empresas de utilities.

Analista de negócio SAP ECC ou S4Hana (Key User) nos módulos CCS em empresa de utilities (água, gás, energia, telecom).

Analista funcional de TI ou consultor funcional SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos SD, FI, PM/PS.

Desenvolvedor SAP ECC ou S4Hana nos módulos CCS, SD, FI, PM/PS com forte base técnica e algum conhecimento funcional destes módulos SAP.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios em pelo menos 2 das 4 áreas abaixo:

Billing: gestão dos diversos ciclos de faturamento por segmento de cliente, geração das faturas/contas, impressão etc

Contract Account: gestão da conta (débitos, créditos, faturas e pagamentos etc) e do contrato com o cliente (Tarifas, datas, status do serviço etc).

Device Management: gestão dos ativos (ex. medidores, locais de instalação). ordens de serviço (instalação, troca, verificação, retirada, histórico etc), leitura de consumo (real, estimada, ajustes)

Sistemas de Informação em Utilities: uso de SAP CCS ou ERPs similares ou custom para empresas do segmento.


Vantagens de participar:

Crescente demanda com a migração para o SAP S/4HANA em empresas de Utilities

Crescimento profissional acelerado e remuneração competitiva

Programa 100% gratuito para os comprometidos

Possibilidade de contratação pela Etho ou parceiros ao final do treinamento


Informações importantes:


Duração: 8 semanas consecutivas, 3 dias por semana: às 2af, 3af, e 5af.

3 horas por sessão, período noturno.


Idioma: não é requerido, mas se tiver aumentam suas chances de participação


Etapas do processo: Triagem|Teste de Raciocínio Lógico|Entrevistas RH e Técnicas


Localização: residir em qualquer lugar do Brasil, preferencialmente para a região de SP, RJ e BH.

Assunto do e-mail:(Bootcamp SAP CCS)

Responsible to deliver design and system configuration for the BRIM module in SAP S/4HANA, ensuring successful rollout and adoption of standardized Service-to-Cash processes across business units. The candidate is responsible for translating business requirements into system solutions, managing data migration, testing, training, and post-go-live support, while aligning with SAP best practices and project timelines.


KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Being part of Global IT team and responsible for SAP BRIM (Billing and Revenue Innovation Management) configuration and associated developments are designed, built, tested & deployed according to S/4 HANA best practices.
  • Facilitate and support workstream managers / Solution Architects & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Sales and Customer Service processes and integration of same with operations, finance & product management workstreams.
  • Analyse business requirements related to subscription order management, subscription billing, contract management, and convergent charging.
  • Configure and customize SAP BRIM components including SOM (Subscription Order Management), CC (Convergent Charging), CI (Convergent Invoicing), and FI-CA (Contract Accounting).
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Perform configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and hyper care activities.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

Essential:

  • Bachelor / master’s degree in business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support experience in BRIM module in S/4 HANA projects with related modules SOM, CI, CC and FI-CA.
  • Hands-on experience in configuring BRIM components and managing end-to-end billing cycles.
  • Understanding on SAP Best Practices in BRIM and SD modules and their integrations & technology.
  • Experience in S/4HANA environment and Fiori applications.
  • Strong communication skills in English, self-driven and motivated.
  • Ability to manage and deliver multiple priorities in a constrained timeline


Desirable:

  • SAP S/4 HANA Certification in SAP BRIM.
  • Knowledge of new features in SAP S/4HANA like embedded analytics, user experience using Fiori, SAP cloud platform
  • Exposure to SAP BTP or cloud-based BRIM extensions.
  • Basic ABAP debugging or familiarity with enhancement frameworks.


WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS

  • Office based/Remote with occasional international travel.
  • Health and Safety accountability statements.
  • Working times are European time zone, however open to be available in APAC/US time zone as well for the need basis.

title: Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
This is mostly manual position. This role is fully remote and is a PJ contractor.


Required Skills & Experience


• 7+ years of experience in Quality Assurance (manual and/or blended QA roles) with strong ownership of test execution and release readiness.

• Jira proficiency for defect tracking, workflows, and reporting.

• Hands-on experience with API testing (e.g., Postman, Swagger, curl, or similar) — note: API work is a smaller portion (~10%).

• Cruise / travel / hotel / hospitality industry experience

• Strong understanding of QA fundamentals: test design, defect lifecycle, SDLC/STLC, and Agile testing practices. Excellent communication skills and ability to partner cross-functionally.


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Experience testing eCommerce, booking engines, reservations, loyalty, payments, check-in/boarding, or guest service platforms.

• Exposure to test automation (any framework/tool) and ability to collaborate with automation engineers (if applicable).

• Basic SQL for validation, data checks, or troubleshooting. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and release processes.


Job Description


We are seeking a Senior QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of customer-facing and internal applications in a fast-paced travel/hospitality environment. This role will partner closely with product, engineering, and delivery teams to define test strategy, execute testing across releases, and continuously improve QA processes. The ideal candidate brings strong hands-on QA experience, deep familiarity with Jira, and working knowledge of API testing (a smaller portion of the overall workload).


Day to Day

• Own and execute end-to-end testing for web and/or mobile applications, including functional, regression, smoke, and UAT support.

• Create and maintain clear test plans, test cases, and test execution evidence aligned to release timelines.

• Work in Agile/Scrum teams to provide early QA input on requirements, acceptance criteria, and edge cases.

• Log, track, and manage defects in Jira, ensuring high-quality documentation and strong follow-through through resolution.

• Perform API validation/testing (estimated ~10% of overall effort) using tools such as Postman/Swagger or similar; validate request/response payloads and integration behaviors.

• Collaborate with engineers and product owners to reproduce issues, validate fixes, and confirm release readiness.

• Help improve QA efficiency through better test coverage, risk-based testing, and repeatable regression approaches. Contribute to quality standards, best practices, and continuous improvement across the SDLC.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).
  • Familiarity with Azure AI services or Microsoft AI Foundry.
  • Strong experience designing API-driven integrations and distributed automation architectures.
  • Experience integrating automation solutions with enterprise data platforms, with a preference for Databricks.
  • Ability to design secure, scalable, and production-ready AI automation solutions.


Preferred Skills:


  • Experience with enterprise RPA platforms such as UiPath or similar.
  • Experience designing multi-agent workflows or human-in-the-loop automation systems.
  • Experience supporting enterprise Automation or AI Centers of Excellence.
  • Expertise in establishing architecture standards, reusable components, and automation governance frameworks.

title: Business Development Manager – Advertisers & Agencies (LATAM)
description:
Company Description

Orange Storm is a leading venture-backed AdTech and AI SaaS company with dual headquarters in California, USA, and Barcelona, Spain. Our integrated ecosystem includes a DSP, SSP, Creative Studio, and an AI-driven analytics platform, empowering publishers and advertisers to make smarter decisions and drive revenue growth. Our global and diverse team thrives in a culture of trust, ownership, and continuous learning. We prioritize collaboration, agile execution, and innovation to deliver scalable, high-performance technologies that adapt to the dynamic AdTech industry.


Role Description

We are looking for a proactive Business Development Manager based in Argentina to help expand our partnerships with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM.

This role focuses on building a strong pipeline through outbound outreach and industry networking. The ideal candidate is someone who enjoys identifying new partners, starting conversations, and turning connections into long-term collaborations.

You will work closely with internal teams to introduce our advertising solutions and onboard new partners.


Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify and connect with advertisers and performance agencies in LATAM
  • Conduct daily outreach through LinkedIn, email, Telegram communities, and other networking channels
  • Build and manage a strong sales pipeline
  • Schedule meetings and introduce our advertising solutions to potential partners
  • Develop relationships with media buyers, agencies, and advertiser teams
  • Support the onboarding process for new partners and coordinate internally with operations teams
  • Maintain long-term relationships and help grow advertiser spend over time
  • Explore creative ways to find partners, including industry communities, social platforms, and events

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of experience in AdTech, performance marketing, affiliate marketing, or digital advertising
  • Strong outbound sales or partnership development mindset
  • Comfortable doing high-volume outreach and networking
  • Excellent English communication skills
  • Based in Argentina
  • Self-motivated and comfortable working in a fast-moving startup environment

Nice to Have

  • Spanish + Portuguese bilingual
  • Experience working with advertisers or performance agencies
  • Existing connections with LATAM advertisers or media buying teams
  • Russian language skills are a plus

What We Offer

  • Competitive base salary + performance-based commission
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Opportunity to grow with an international AdTech company
  • Direct exposure to the global digital advertising ecosystem

Ideal Candidate

Someone who:

  • Enjoys building pipeline and starting new conversations
  • Is creative in finding potential partners and opportunities
  • Is proactive and comfortable reaching out to new people
  • Wants to grow in the AdTech and performance marketing industry

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
About Mosaic Puzzles

Mosaic Puzzles is a jigsaw puzzle company based in Alpharetta, Georgia. We design and build unique wooden puzzles where every piece is part of the story. Our collections blend intricate art, clever cut designs, and premium craftsmanship.


We’re a fast-paced, growing startup led by former Uber and Amazon team members, and we’re looking for someone excited to move quickly and contribute ideas that make a real impact.


Check our website for more information:


Position Overview

We’re looking for a creative, detail-oriented, and results-driven Marketing Specialist to join our team. This role combines strong execution skills with analytical thinking and excellent project management.


This role supports the planning and execution of marketing initiatives across multiple channels including email, SMS, social media, and website content. The ideal candidate is highly organized, comfortable working with data, and able to manage multiple marketing projects simultaneously.


You will work closely with other company departments to execute campaigns, analyze performance, and continuously improve how customers discover and engage with our products.


Key Responsibilities


Marketing Strategy & Campaign Execution

  • Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across email, SMS, social media, website content, and seasonal promotions.
  • Coordinate campaign timelines and marketing calendars to support product launches, seasonal initiatives, and brand campaigns.
  • Support lifecycle marketing initiatives including newsletters, SMS campaigns, product launches, and promotional moments.
  • Collaborate with the team to identify marketing opportunities and propose ideas that improve campaign performance.



Content & Brand Communication

  • Write clear, engaging copy for newsletters, SMS campaigns, social media, blog posts, and other marketing materials.
  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all marketing channels.
  • Coordinate content calendars aligned with seasonal themes, product launches, and marketing priorities.
  • Monitor social media conversations and user-generated content to identify engagement opportunities.


Digital Marketing & Analytics

  • Track and analyze campaign performance across email, SMS, social media, and website channels.
  • Interpret marketing data and provide actionable insights to improve campaign performance.
  • Assist with SEO initiatives including keyword research, content optimization, and website improvements.
  • Support customer surveys and feedback analysis to help inform product and marketing decisions.


Project Management & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Manage multiple marketing projects and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Work with designers, photographers, videographers, and other cross-functional partners to prepare creative briefs and campaign assets.
  • Ensure marketing initiatives are delivered on time and aligned with campaign goals.
  • Maintain a high level of organization and attention to detail across all marketing initiatives.


Requirements

  • Fluent in English (C1 level or higher). Exceptional written and spoken communication is essential.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience in marketing, digital marketing, or content marketing.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing analytics and performance tracking .
  • Strong organizational and project management skills.
  • Experience working with email and SMS marketing platforms such as Mailchimp, Attentive, or similar tools.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Proactive mindset with the ability to suggest ideas and take initiative.
  • Strong copywriting skills with a knack for storytelling and brand voice.
  • Experience managing social media accounts and understanding platform best practices.
  • Solid understanding of digital marketing principles, including email marketing and social content strategy.
  • Knowledge of SEO is a plus.


How to Apply

Candidates must submit their resumes in English. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.


Mosaic Cultural Values Alignment

The ideal candidate will embody Mosaic’s cultural values, including:

  • Owner’s Mindset: Working hard, helping others, and proactively contributing.
  • Process Orientation: Showing your work and thinking ahead.
  • Moving Quickly: Taking initiative and being proactive.
  • Taking Responsibility: Owning your actions.
  • Valuing Ideas Over Hierarchy: Contributing creatively and openly.
  • Continuous Improvement: Always seeking better ways to work.
  • Doing the Right Thing: Acting with integrity.
  • Believing in Meritocracy: Recognizing and rewarding performance.
  • Resourcefulness: Finding cost-effective and practical solutions.

title: AI Solution Architect
description:
Location / Remote: Remote -- Candidates who reside outside the United States will be considered.


Time Zone: Must be willing to work Eastern Timezone Hours


Communication : Only candidates with professional-level English proficiency will be considered.


Employment Type: 12-month contract (W-2, C2C).


Compensation: Up to 33 U.S. dollars per hour (depending on experience).


This role focuses on designing and delivering enterprise-grade AI-driven automation solutions. The Agentic Solutions Architect will play a hands-on role in architecting secure, scalable, and production-ready intelligent automation systems that integrate AI agents, enterprise platforms, APIs, and data systems. Success in this position requires deep technical expertise, a strong understanding of automation architecture, and the ability to guide teams in implementing innovative AI solutions.


Responsibilities:


  • Architect enterprise-grade intelligent automation solutions integrating AI agents, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
  • Design and implement multi-step workflows involving AI agents, RPA bots, and enterprise applications.
  • Establish architecture patterns for orchestration, exception handling, approvals, and auditability.
  • Leverage Microsoft Copilot and Power Platform AI tools, including Copilot Studio and Power Automate.
  • Architect secure integrations between AI agents, automation platforms, and enterprise data systems, particularly Databricks.
  • Provide technical leadership and guidance to development teams.
  • Evaluate emerging agent technologies and recommend best practices for adoption.
  • Develop repeatable architecture standards, patterns, and governance practices for AI automation.


Required Skills:


  • 7+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise automation architecture, or similar roles.
  • Proven experience delivering AI-driven or intelligent automation solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on expertise with Microsoft Copilot / Power Platform AI capabilities (e.g., Copilot Studio, Power Automate).

title: Analista de Growth Pleno — Jornada do Cliente & Conversão (ChatBot WhatsApp)
description:
Vaga para modelo de contratação PJ


Remoto


A ConCrédito é uma das maiores correspondentes bancárias do Brasil, especializada em crédito consignado nas modalidades CLT, INSS e FGTS. Com mais de 300 mil clientes atendidos via WhatsApp, a ConCrédito preza pelo bom atendimento e pela experiência do cliente, comprovados pelas mais de 21 mil avaliações positivas no Google Meu Negócio.


O Papel

O Analista de Growth Pleno será o principal responsável pela jornada do cliente no chatbot do WhatsApp, o maior canal de aquisição e relacionamento da empresa. A missão é clara: reduzir atrito, combater o abandono e maximizar o Lifetime Value (LTV) da base de leads e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Mapear e otimizar o funil conversacional de ponta a ponta, identificando gargalos nas micro e macroconversões.
  • Rodar testes A/B contínuos em mensagens, copywriting, timing de follow-ups e arquitetura dos fluxos.
  • Criar e gerir réguas de relacionamento, ativação de leads frios e campanhas de reengajamento.
  • Auxiliar na construção de dashboards de acompanhamento da jornada em parceria com o time de Dados (Snowflake, Power BI).
  • Refinar clusters de audiência para personalização em escala.
  • Atuar de forma cross-functional com os times de Marketing, Vendas, BI e Produto/Tech.


KPIs sob sua gestão

  • Ativação: taxa de ativação de leads recém-chegados ao chatbot.
  • Conversão do funil: eficiência na passagem entre etapas do fluxo conversacional.
  • Taxa de abandono: redução de drop-off em cada estágio da jornada.
  • Time-to-convert: redução do tempo médio para contratação efetiva.
  • Retenção e recompra: aumento do LTV e da frequência de uso dos serviços.
  • ROI de campanhas: retorno sobre campanhas de repescagem e disparos via WhatsApp.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Capacidade técnica de uso ou criação de agentes de IA, independentemente da ferramenta ou framework (Claude, Manus, Antigravity…).
  • Experiência sólida como Analista de Growth, CRO, Lifecycle Marketing, CRM ou Produto, com foco em conversão.
  • Capacidade analítica avançada: métricas de funil, análise de cohort, LTV e CAC.
  • Vivência prática com otimização de chatbots, automação de mensagens e WhatsApp API oficial.
  • Domínio de frameworks de growth hacking e testes A/B.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de visualização de dados.
  • Boa comunicação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócios.


Diferenciais valorizados

  • Experiência prévia em fintechs, mercado de crédito ou operações B2C com alto volume de leads.
  • Conhecimento na plataforma ColmeIA ou chats conversacionais similares.
  • Habilidades em SQL e ferramentas como Metabase ou Supabase.
  • Familiaridade com IA aplicada à personalização de fluxos conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em automação com N8N.


Essa vaga NÃO é para você se:

  • Você é mais executor do que estrategista e não tem experiência otimizando funis de conversão.
  • Sua experiência está focada em social media, branding ou marketing de conteúdo.
  • Você trabalha apenas com análise de dados, sem transformar insights em ações práticas.
  • Sua atuação em growth é mais teórica do que prática (cursos, conceitos, pouca execução real).
  • Você nunca lidou com alto volume de leads ou operações em escala.
  • Seu foco é apenas aquisição (tráfego pago) e não conversão ao longo da jornada.
  • Você não tem experiência com chatbots, automação de mensagens ou fluxos conversacionais.
  • Você precisa de direcionamento constante e não tem autonomia para testar, iterar e tomar decisões.
