title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Analista de Processos e Projetos Jr (híbrido em Salvador/BA)
description:

description:

Engenharia de Produção, Engenharia Mecânica, Administração, Gestão da Qualidade ou áreas correlatas;

title: Supervisor de produção
description:
Descrição da vaga

Realizar gestão de pessoas com foco em maximizar faturamento, qualidade, produtividade, segurança e meio ambiente, conservação de equipamentos, disciplina e motivação dos colaboradores, coordenar e desenvolver trabalhos de melhoria continua, otimizando processos e recursos, com objetivo de realizar a produção com qualidade total e atender as necessidades dos clientes internos e externos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições: 

  • Supervisionar a equipe de trabalho conforme demanda de produção apontada pelo PCP;
  • Fazer a distribuição de tarefas da equipe considerando prazos de entrega, diretrizes de segurança e normas de qualidade já estabelecidos previamente;
  • Analisar e distribuir as ordens de produção, conforme o equipamento a ser utilizando na produção;
  • Liderar projetos focados em eliminação/ redução dos riscos de segurança juntamente com o setor de segurança do trabalho dentro da sua área de responsabilidade;
  • Minimizar o tempo de setup dos equipamentos com o alinhamento dos pedidos de mesma montagem, definindo prioridades e acompanhamento;
  • Acompanhar o abastecimento de ferramental e matéria prima para otimizar o processo reduzindo o lead time;
  • Garantir o cumprimento e a qualidade de todas as entregas programadas;
  • Treinar novos funcionários sobre como usar as máquinas com segurança e seguir os procedimentos;
  • Fazer o controle de insumos de matéria prima e embalagens para expedição;
  • Realizar gestão de pessoas com interface do setor de recursos humanos, controlando ponto, férias, performance e necessidades dos empregados, visando o comprometimento e motivação;
  • Coordenar e desenvolver trabalhos de manufatura enxuta (Lean manufacturing);
  • Zelar pela conservação dos equipamentos do setor, por meio da solicitação de serviços de manutenção, sempre que necessário, e do apoio na elaboração de planos de manutenção preventiva;
  • Participar das auditorias internas e externas realizadas no seu departamento de modo a esclarecer possíveis dúvidas bem como apresentar as áreas e procedimentos;
  • Realizar a investigação de desvios de modo a propor planos de ação para evitar reincidência.


Necessário disponibilidade para atuar em turnos.

title: Analista de Relações com Investidores
description:
Sobre a LCP

A Life Capital Partners (LCP) é uma gestora independente de recursos brasileira fundada por empreendedores e investidores que possuem um extenso track record na indústria de Investimentos Alternativos e Transações Estruturadas no Brasil e em mercados internacionais. A LCP investe em diversas classes de ativo, incluindo Real Estate, Sports Media e Private Equity.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional proativo(a), organizado(a) e com forte habilidade de relacionamento para integrar nossa equipe de Relações com Investidores. Entre as principais responsabilidades da posição, estão:

  • Prospecção, desenvolvimento e manutenção de relacionamento com parceiros estratégicos e investidores, incluindo AAIs, MFOs, SFOs, corretoras, distribuidores e demais participantes do mercado;
  • Condução e acompanhamento de reuniões periódicas com clientes, parceiros e potenciais investidores, garantindo proximidade comercial e alinhamento institucional;
  • Suporte à agenda comercial e institucional dos gestores, incluindo acompanhamento de reuniões com analistas de mercado, influenciadores e stakeholders relevantes;
  • Elaboração, atualização e aprimoramento de apresentações institucionais, materiais comerciais, roadshows e demais materiais de apoio relacionados aos fundos e à gestora;
  • Produção e atualização de relatórios de acompanhamento de performance dos fundos, bem como de materiais de monitoramento gerencial e mercadológico;
  • Acompanhamento da indústria e análise comparativa de peers, ofertas públicas e tendências de mercado, com foco em geração de inteligência para a área de RI;
  • Interface com as frentes de marketing e comunicação para apoiar a manutenção das redes sociais, conteúdos institucionais e ações de posicionamento da gestora e dos fundos;
  • Apoio na organização de eventos, visitas, reuniões comerciais e demais iniciativas de relacionamento com investidores e distribuidores.


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Administração, Economia, Engenharia, Relações Internacionais ou áreas correlatas;
  • Domínio do Pacote Office;
  • Inglês fluente;
  • Habilidade de comunicação / relacionamento;
  • Capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico, autoaprendizagem e solução de problemas;
  • Conhecimento prévio do mercado de fundos será considerado um diferencial;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Curitiba/PR, no bairro Batel.

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Clojure Software Engineer
description:
Clojure Software Engineer, Shopper Inspiration (Backend)


Full-Time | EST Hours | USD $5,000–$9,000/month | Long-Term Contractor


At Latino Legends , we are partnering with a well-established technology company building AI-powered solutions for large-scale retail and e-commerce platforms.


About Our Client


Our client develops enterprise-grade AI systems that power personalization, product discovery, and automated merchandising experiences across web, mobile, email, and in-store channels. Their technology reaches more than 100 million shoppers each month through 175+ major retail brands.


What sets them apart is not just cutting-edge AI — it’s over a decade of proprietary retail data, refined workflows, quality controls, and domain expertise. Their focus is on delivering reliable, brand-safe, production-grade AI systems that perform consistently at enterprise scale.


About the Role


We’re looking for a Clojure craftsperson who thrives in backend-heavy environments and is excited about building real AI systems that operate at massive scale.


You’ll help build:


  • AI workflows that generate outfit images, styled bundles, and “Complete the Look” recommendations
  • Systems that intelligently pair products to increase AOV and conversion
  • Human-in-the-loop review flows where AI-generated content is validated and improved
  • Vector search architectures powering semantic discovery and product similarity
  • High-scale APIs serving 175+ enterprise retailers and 100M+ shoppers monthly


You’ll work across Clojure and ClojureScript , owning features end-to-end — from schema design and backend services to internal review UIs used daily by the team.


The engineering team includes 12+ Clojure engineers who move quickly, care deeply about code quality, and value ownership. This is a high-autonomy environment where you’ll architect solutions, make technical decisions, and ship production-ready systems.


What You’ll Do


  • Design and implement Temporal workflows orchestrating multi-step AI operations (product attribution, image generation, outfit creation, copy generation)
  • Build backend services in Clojure integrating with LLM APIs (GPT, Gemini, etc.)
  • Manage prompts, context windows, streaming responses, and structured outputs
  • Design PostgreSQL schemas supporting complex AI workflows and vector embeddings
  • Implement RAG pipelines using Qdrant for semantic search and similarity matching
  • Develop ClojureScript UIs for human review and validation workflows
  • Build APIs and data pipelines that connect AI systems to the broader platform
  • Implement monitoring systems to track AI quality and reliability


Required Technologies


  • Clojure
  • PostgreSQL
  • AI / LLM Integration & Management
  • Advanced English


Must-Have Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Strong production experience with Clojure and ClojureScript
  • Deep understanding of functional programming principles
  • Solid SQL and database design experience (PostgreSQL)
  • Experience integrating LLMs into production systems
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals (APIs, data flow, system design)
  • Ability to ship quickly while maintaining quality
  • Ownership mindset — from conception to production
  • Curiosity about AI, vector search, orchestration, and system architecture


Nice-to-Have


  • Experience with Java and JVM ecosystem
  • Experience with Temporal, Airflow, Dagster, or Step Functions
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate)
  • Experience building RAG architectures
  • Exposure to multimodal AI or image generation systems
  • Contributions to open-source Clojure projects
  • Background in other functional languages (Haskell, OCaml, Elixir, Scala)
  • Experience building developer tools or human-in-the-loop workflows


Our Client’s Core Values


  • Deliver high-quality work
  • Be exceptional partners
  • Execute with urgency
  • Believe the right team matters most
  • Think like customers, act like owners
  • Embrace innovation and pioneering solutions


Hiring Process


Their streamlined process moves quickly while giving candidates a fair opportunity to demonstrate their strengths:


  • 15–20 Minute Live Coding Challenge – Focused on fundamentals and problem-solving
  • Cultural Fit Interview – Alignment on communication, collaboration, and mindset
  • Final Technical Live Coding Session – Real-world scenario simulation

What sets them apart is not just cutting-edge AI — it’s over a decade of proprietary retail data, refined workflows, quality controls, and domain expertise. Their focus is on delivering reliable, brand-safe, production-grade AI systems that perform consistently at enterprise scale.


About the Role


We’re looking for a Clojure craftsperson who thrives in backend-heavy environments and is excited about building real AI systems that operate at massive scale.


You’ll help build:


  • AI workflows that generate outfit images, styled bundles, and “Complete the Look” recommendations
  • Systems that intelligently pair products to increase AOV and conversion
  • Human-in-the-loop review flows where AI-generated content is validated and improved
  • Vector search architectures powering semantic discovery and product similarity
  • High-scale APIs serving 175+ enterprise retailers and 100M+ shoppers monthly


You’ll work across Clojure and ClojureScript , owning features end-to-end — from schema design and backend services to internal review UIs used daily by the team.


The engineering team includes 12+ Clojure engineers who move quickly, care deeply about code quality, and value ownership. This is a high-autonomy environment where you’ll architect solutions, make technical decisions, and ship production-ready systems.


What You’ll Do


  • Design and implement Temporal workflows orchestrating multi-step AI operations (product attribution, image generation, outfit creation, copy generation)
  • Build backend services in Clojure integrating with LLM APIs (GPT, Gemini, etc.)
  • Manage prompts, context windows, streaming responses, and structured outputs
  • Design PostgreSQL schemas supporting complex AI workflows and vector embeddings
  • Implement RAG pipelines using Qdrant for semantic search and similarity matching
  • Develop ClojureScript UIs for human review and validation workflows
  • Build APIs and data pipelines that connect AI systems to the broader platform
  • Implement monitoring systems to track AI quality and reliability


Required Technologies


  • Clojure
  • PostgreSQL
  • AI / LLM Integration & Management
  • Advanced English


Must-Have Qualifications


  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field
  • Strong production experience with Clojure and ClojureScript
  • Deep understanding of functional programming principles
  • Solid SQL and database design experience (PostgreSQL)
  • Experience integrating LLMs into production systems
  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals (APIs, data flow, system design)
  • Ability to ship quickly while maintaining quality
  • Ownership mindset — from conception to production
  • Curiosity about AI, vector search, orchestration, and system architecture


Nice-to-Have


  • Experience with Java and JVM ecosystem
  • Experience with Temporal, Airflow, Dagster, or Step Functions
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Qdrant, Pinecone, Weaviate)
  • Experience building RAG architectures
  • Exposure to multimodal AI or image generation systems
  • Contributions to open-source Clojure projects
  • Background in other functional languages (Haskell, OCaml, Elixir, Scala)
  • Experience building developer tools or human-in-the-loop workflows


Our Client’s Core Values


  • Deliver high-quality work
  • Be exceptional partners
  • Execute with urgency
  • Believe the right team matters most
  • Think like customers, act like owners
  • Embrace innovation and pioneering solutions


Hiring Process


Their streamlined process moves quickly while giving candidates a fair opportunity to demonstrate their strengths:


  • 15–20 Minute Live Coding Challenge – Focused on fundamentals and problem-solving
  • Cultural Fit Interview – Alignment on communication, collaboration, and mindset
  • Final Technical Live Coding Session – Real-world scenario simulation

title: Programador Fullstack Sênior - Python | React JS
description:
Sobre o Projeto:


Estamos selecionando profissionais para compor nosso time de engenharia de software, onde você participará de todas as fases dos projetos, da arquitetura à produção, com tecnologias de ponta em um ambiente dinâmico. Buscamos um(a) profissional sênior com forte experiência em Python para liderar o desenvolvimento da nossa esteira de dados e dos serviços de backend analíticos, sendo peça-chave na fundação de dados que alimentará nossas plataformas e futuros modelos de Inteligência Artificial.


Suas Responsabilidades:


  • Desenhar e implementar a arquitetura da esteira de dados (ingestão batch/streaming, transformação, qualidade e catalogação);
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT assíncronos para nosso Data Lake e Data Warehouse;
  • Projetar e construir serviços de backend robustos e escaláveis em Python (FastAPI e Django);
  • Estruturar e gerenciar bancos de dados analíticos (OLAP, Big Data), garantindo performance;
  • Colaborar diretamente com o Especialista em IA para preparar, versionar e vetorizar dados para treinamento de modelos e sistemas RAG;
  • Desenvolver APIs (REST/GraphQL) seguras e performáticas;
  • Colaborar no desenvolvimento do front-end com React JS;
  • Garantir a implementação de requisitos não funcionais como segurança, escalabilidade, observabilidade (logs, métricas, traces) e CI/CD;
  • Produzir documentação técnica de alta qualidade (diagramas de arquitetura, ADRs).


Requisitos Essenciais:


  • Superior completo em Engenharia da Computação ou afins ;
  • Sólida experiência (5+ anos) em desenvolvimento backend com Python;
  • Proficiência em desenvolvimento front-end com React JS e seus ecossistemas (Redux, Hooks, etc.);
  • Conhecimento profundo em modelagem e otimização de bancos de dados relacionais (ex: PostgreSQL) e não relacionais/analíticos;
  • Experiência na construção e consumo de APIs RESTful e GraphQL;
  • Prática com conteinerização (Docker) e orquestração (Kubernetes é um diferencial);
  • Familiaridade com práticas de DevOps e ferramentas de CI/CD (GitLab CI);
  • Conhecimento sólido em segurança da informação (OAuth2/OIDC, criptografia, LGPD).


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com provedores de nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible).
  • Experiência com sistemas de mensageria (RabbitMQ, Kafka).
  • Noções de Machine Learning e preparação de dados para IA.


Rotina e Local:


  • Local : Polo II de Alta Tecnologia de Campinas-SP
  • Modalidade: Presencial - 40h semanais

title: Brazilian Portuguese Teacher
description:
We're hiring! BORA Portuguese is looking for Brazilian Portuguese teachers.


BORA Portuguese is an online school that teaches real, spoken Brazilian Portuguese to English-speaking adults around the world. No textbook stiffness — we teach the way Brazilians actually talk, blending grammar, conversation, and cultural expressions into every lesson.


We're growing and looking for new teachers to join the team!


What you'll do:

→ Plan and deliver engaging online lessons

→ Provide meaningful feedback and track student progress

→ Build clear, empathetic, and culturally relevant connections with students


What we're looking for:

→ Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese (C2 level or equivalent)

→ Fluent or professional-level English

→ Experience teaching Portuguese to foreign/international students (1+ year preferred)

→ Strong communication skills and a student-centered approach

→ Knowledge of modern language teaching techniques that go beyond the textbook

→ Comfortable with online teaching tools

→ Flexible schedule (our students are in different time zones!)

→ A proper workspace with good lighting, camera, mic, and stable internet connection


Nice to have:

→ Degree in Letras or related field

→ PLE certification (Portuguese as a Foreign Language)


The role:

→ Independent contractor (freelance)

→ Fully remote — teach from wherever you are

→ Hours based on student demand

→ Structured materials and curriculum provided


If you're passionate about teaching Brazilian Portuguese and want to be part of a growing school with a lot of personality, we'd love to hear from you.


Send an email to with your CV and a short intro about yourself.

title: TECNICO DE SEGURANÇA DO TRABALHO
description:
Sobre a Empresa


É uma tradicional fabricante de bebidas brasileira, fundada em 1951 em Itu (SP) e conhecida pelo sabor autêntico de seu guaraná. Com unidade fabril no Rio de Janeiro desde 1983, a empresa destaca-se pela produção de refrigerantes populares


Responsabilidades


  • Realizar inspeções de Segurança do Trabalho, verificando as condições físicas do local, máquinas e equipamentos, procedimentos dos funcionários etc.
  • Visando à prevenção de acidentes de trabalho bem como a prevenção de doenças ocupacionais dos funcionários em atendimento às Normas Regulamentadoras.


Qualificações


  • Curso Nível Médio de Técnico em Segurança no Trabalho.
  • Experiência comprovada em carteira na área da segurança do trabalho mínimo 1 ano.



Habilidades Necessárias


  • Possuir sólidos conhecimentos em Normas Regulamentadoras (NRs), capacidade de análise de riscos, excelente comunicação e proatividade. Habilidades comportamentais como empatia, inteligência emocional e negociação são essenciais para promover a cultura de segurança e garantir o uso correto de EPIs/EPCs.


Habilidades Preferenciais


  • Comunicação Efetiva e Treinamento: Habilidade para transmitir normas técnicas de forma clara, realizar palestras (DDS) e treinar equipes, atuando como ponte entre funcionários e gestão.
  • Proatividade e Antecipação de Riscos: Capacidade de agir antes que acidentes ocorram, identificando perigos no ambiente de trabalho e propondo medidas preventivas.
  • Conhecimento Técnico Sólido: Domínio das NRs, legislação previdenciária e trabalhista, além de interpretação de riscos ambientais.
  • Gestão de Crises e Resolução de Problemas: Agilidade para tomar decisões sob pressão e encontrar soluções práticas para garantir a segurança.
  • Liderança e Empatia: Habilidade para influenciar o comportamento dos colaboradores, promovendo uma cultura de prevenção, ao invés de apenas fiscalizar.
  • Atualização Contínua: Capacidade de adaptação a mudanças nas normas e novas tecnologias de segurança.

title: Graphic Designer/Carousel Creator (Canva focused)
description:
Job Title: Creative Designer (Canva & Video Content)


Type: Remote | Part-Time (20 hours/week; 4 hours/day)


Client: Fast-growing DTC Beauty & Wellness Brand focused on premium skincare, longevity, and lifestyle content, with a strong community of women interested in science-backed skincare and wellness.


Overview

We are looking for a Creative Designer to support a content-driven personal brand by creating visually engaging social media assets. This role focuses on designing carousel content using Canva and assisting with light video editing.


You will work closely with the founders to translate ideas, references, and written content (e.g., Google Docs or sample carousels) into polished visuals that align with the brand’s style.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design social media carousel posts using Canva based on provided content or references
  • Translate Google Docs or example content into visually consistent, on-brand designs
  • Replicate and adapt existing carousel styles to match the brand’s visual identity
  • Assist with basic video editing for social media content
  • Collaborate with the team to ensure designs align with the intended messaging and style
  • Maintain consistency in layout, formatting, and overall visual presentation


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in Canva for creating social media content
  • Strong sense of visual design, layout, and consistency
  • Ability to follow brand style and replicate design references accurately
  • Comfortable working with content provided in documents (e.g., Google Docs) and turning it into visuals
  • Video editing skills
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Figma or other advanced design tools (nice to have)


Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Detail-oriented with strong execution skills
  • Able to take direction and translate ideas into clean, engaging designs
  • Comfortable working in a collaborative, feedback-driven environment
  • Interested in content creation and visual storytelling

title: Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer (Full Stack, AI + Data Systems)
description:
Job Description

We’re a stealth startup backed by a repeat founder and top-tier investors.


We’re rebuilding the financial plumbing behind a trillion-dollar asset class — commercial real estate insurance — one of the largest, most archaic financial systems in the United States.


Today, this market still runs on manual workflows, fragmented data, and decades-old infrastructure.

Our top competitors represent over $300B in combined market value, and the core workflows in this industry have not been meaningfully disrupted in decades.


We’re building an AI-native platform that ingests fragmented insurance data across documents, APIs, and third-party systems, and transforms it into a unified, structured layer for underwriting and decision-making.


Incubated by a team that has already built two successful companies in this exact industry and ICP, we’re now assembling a world-class team to build the next one.


We are assembling the Avengers of financial services and insurance tech — a small, elite team of builders who want to define this category.


We’re looking for a Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer to ensure every data point we produce is correct, reliable, and production-ready.


This is not traditional QA. This is owning quality across AI systems, data pipelines, and critical financial infrastructure — where silent failures are unacceptable.


The Role

As the Founding QA / Test Automation Engineer, you will:

- Own testing across the full stack — frontend, backend, and AI/ML outputs

- Build testing infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines from scratch

- Design regression frameworks to detect accuracy drift across model and prompt changes

- Validate complex data pipelines where correctness is non-negotiable

- Define and enforce quality standards across deterministic systems and AI/ML outputs

- Work directly with founders and engineers to ship quickly without compromising quality

- Set the bar for all future QA and engineering hires


What You’ll Own

- End-to-end validation of data and document processing systems from ingestion through structured output

- Regression frameworks to ensure accuracy and consistency across evolving AI/ML systems

- API integration testing and validation of external data flows

- Frontend critical user flows across core product experiences

- CI/CD pipelines and automated quality gates across the stack

- Monitoring and alerting for production systems to ensure reliability at scale


Who Are You?

- You’ve tested systems where correctness actually matters (financial data, insurance, data infrastructure, or document processing)

- Experience at high-growth startups where speed and quality both matter

- You understand how to validate data pipelines and AI/ML outputs — not just web apps

- You’ve built or want to build automated testing frameworks from scratch

- Comfortable operating across backend systems, APIs, and frontend applications

- Highly technical, AI-native, and systems-oriented

- Relentless attention to detail — you catch what others miss


Technical Skills

- Python (pytest or similar)

- Playwright or Cypress

- CI/CD (GitHub Actions or similar)

- Experience testing APIs, data pipelines, and distributed systems


Bonus:

- Experience testing LLM or AI systems

- Experience building regression or evaluation frameworks

- Experience with document processing or OCR systems

- Experience working in insurance or insurtech environments


Culture & Expectations

This is an intense, output-driven environment.

We operate at high velocity with a small team of exceptional builders.

We operate on a 9-9-6 cadence — because rebuilding an industry demands it.

High ownership. High accountability. High standards.

We don’t care about pedigree, background, or years of experience. We care about ability.

We are looking for the top 0.0001% — people who take pride in building systems that must work.


Logistics

- Quarterly trips to NYC for collaboration


Compensation

Competitive salary

Meaningful equity

Leadership path fully uncapped for the right person


Who This Is Ideal For

A QA / Test Automation engineer who has operated as a founding or early QA hire (#1/#2) at a high-growth startup, or someone who has built and scaled testing infrastructure in fast-moving environments. You should genuinely believe you are the strongest QA engineers in any room and want the opportunity to own quality end-to-end — from building the testing foundation to shaping how an entire engineering organization thinks about correctness and reliability.


Why Join Now?

You’d be joining at the exact moment when:

- The company is fully incubated and de-risked by proven founders

- Two successful companies have already been built in this domain

- The wedge is validated, pipeline active, customers already aligned

- The market is at a breaking point and demanding change

- The next 18 months will define a multi-billion-dollar outcome


If you’re hungry, relentless, and want to help rearchitect a trillion-dollar market — reach out. There aren’t many chances to be this early on something this big.

title: Online English Teacher
description:
Online English Teacher (Remote)


If you are passionate about teaching and love to see students improve quickly, you are perfect for this role.


Create English is the online arm of LivEnglish — the renowned in-person immersion and the fastest-growing intensive language program for business executives.


The Method


The method is unique and unprecedented, being the only constructivist approach to language teaching.

We do not use lesson materials or course books. You will learn how to extract content from students and help them master it.


Our method encourages the use of Portuguese and translations in order to allow for authentic real-life practice.


The Ideal Teacher


We are seeking English teachers who are fluent in English and have a good command of Portuguese .

This professional will be responsible for teaching English language skills to business professionals in an online setting.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Teach one-on-one 20 min English classes to adults from basic to advanced levels
  • Follow the established teaching method
  • Fill out attendance and performance reports on students


REQUIREMENTS :

  • Full proficiency in English (C2)
  • Registered as Pessoa Jurídica (PJ) in Brazil
  • Intermediate or above level of Portuguese
  • Previous teaching experience
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection
  • Quiet, interruption-free workspace
  • Business knowledge is a plus
  • A sociable and communicative personality


Working Schedule:

Monday to Friday, in one of the following daily schedules:


WORK SCHEDULE A

7h to 10h

+ 12h to 14h

+ 16h to 18h30

(all 3 time slots combined)


WORK SCHEDULE B

9h to 11h

+ 13h to 15h

+ 17h to 20h30

(all 3 time slots combined)


PLEASE ONLY APPLY FOR THIS POSITION IF YOU HAVE ONE OF THE DAILY WORK SCHEDULES AVAILABLE!


Monthly Compensation:

1st and 2nd months: R$ 3,500.00

3rd and 4th months: R$ 3.750,00

5th month and after: R$ 4,000.00


Unique Payment Structure

A great advantage of our format is that you get paid for all the time you reserve for the students, regardless of whether they show up for class or not.


The student also has no discounts for cancelling or not showing up.

We also don’t offer replacement classes in case of cancellation or no-show.


This way we protect teachers payments and schedules.


Additional Opportunity for São Paulo residents:

Many of our online teachers also participate in our in-person immersions at LivEnglish.


So, in addition to this online position, if you live in the São Paulo city, you can also apply for the position of English teacher at the LivEnglish in-person immersions.


You could earn an additional R$ 1.200,00 for a weekend immersion. Let us know in the application if you'd like to apply for the LivEnglish immersion too.


Check out @imersaoemingles on Instagram to see what our immersions are like :-)


Payment is made to Brazilian banks only.


We look forward to meeting you!

title: Tech Lead Python
description:
Sobre a Alterego

A Alterego é uma consultoria especializada em Customer Experience (CX), certificada ISO 9001:2015. Unimos estratégia, operação e tecnologia para desenhar e implementar transformações reais ao longo de toda a jornada do cliente, com impacto direto em eficiência operacional, redução de custos, qualidade, produtividade e fortalecimento do relacionamento.

Para sustentar essa transformação na prática, estruturamos e entregamos soluções de automação e IA aplicada a CX, conectando dados, processos e canais para otimizar jornadas, elevar desempenho e acelerar a transformação digital em setores como serviços financeiros, varejo, telecomunicações e saúde.

Atuamos de forma pragmática, hands-on, entregando soluções que geram ROI de verdade.


A Oportunidade

Buscamos um(a) Tech Lead para atuar como líder técnico da Squad. Não procuramos apenas quem toma decisões técnicas — procuramos quem garante coerência arquitetural, qualidade técnica, previsibilidade de entrega e redução de risco operacional.

O Tech Lead é o elo entre estratégia de solução, execução técnica e PMO. Você orientará decisões técnicas, apoiará o time de desenvolvimento e assegurará que as entregas estejam aderentes aos padrões da Alterego.


Responsabilidades

Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura:

  • Definir e sustentar a arquitetura técnica das soluções da Squad.
  • Tomar decisões sobre arquitetura de APIs, integrações, automação e persistência de dados.
  • Garantir coerência técnica entre diferentes projetos.


Execução e Qualidade:

  • Atuar hands-on em pontos críticos de arquitetura e integrações complexas.
  • Garantir boas práticas: qualidade de código, versionamento, segurança e rastreabilidade.
  • Conduzir code reviews com foco em qualidade e sustentabilidade técnica.

Coordenação com PMO e Produto:

  • Atuar com PMO no desenho e refinamento técnico das soluções.
  • Apoiar estimativas técnicas, análise de riscos e viabilidade.
  • Traduzir necessidades de negócio em direcionamentos técnicos claros.


Desenvolvimento do Time:

  • Orientar e desenvolver tecnicamente desenvolvedores plenos e juniores.
  • Promover boas práticas e autonomia.
  • Garantir alinhamento técnico com os padrões da Alterego.


Requisitos

Obrigatórios:

·        Experiência sólida como Tech Lead, Senior Developer ou papel equivalente.

·        Domínio de Python 3.x (tipagem, PEP8/PEP257, async/await).

·        Experiência com Django e/ou FastAPI.

·        Forte experiência em APIs REST.

·        Vivência em integrações complexas entre múltiplos sistemas.

·        Conhecimento em Pandas e SQLAlchemy.

·        Capacidade de avaliar trade-offs técnicos e tomar decisões orientadas a risco, prazo e qualidade.


Desejáveis:

·        Bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server) e NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis).

·        Docker, CI/CD (GitHub Actions), Kubernetes.

·        Experiência em automação, RPA, IA/ML ou integração de sistemas corporativos.


Diferenciais:

·        Atuação em fábrica de software ou ambientes multi-projeto.

·        Vivência em projetos de alto risco operacional ou sistemas críticos.

·        Experiência em ambientes com restrições de acesso ou integrações indiretas.


O Que Oferecemos

  • Papel estruturante com impacto direto na qualidade das entregas e evolução da fábrica.
  • Responsabilidade contínua sobre a saúde técnica da Squad.
  • Projetos de alto impacto em transformação digital e otimização de jornadas.
  • Stack moderno: Python 3.x, Django/FastAPI, Docker, CI/CD, GCP.
  • Autonomia para definir arquiteturas e padrões técnicos.
  • Oportunidade de liderança técnica e desenvolvimento de profissionais.
  • 100% remoto.


Modelo de Contratação e Remuneração

·        Contratação no modelo PJ (Pessoa Jurídica).

·        Remuneração alinhada à senioridade Júnior e às práticas de mercado para tecnologia.

·        Evolução financeira vinculada a crescimento técnico e entregas.

·        Atuação 100% remota.


Transparência

Você atuará em projetos de alto risco operacional, onde decisões arquiteturais impactam diretamente operações críticas. A posição requer capacidade de equilibrar qualidade técnica, prazo e risco, além de responsabilidade pela evolução técnica de outros profissionais.

Envie currículo + portfólio/GitHub para:

Assunto: \"Tech Lead Python - (Seu Nome)\"

Processo: 4 etapas, ~2-3 semanas (resposta em 48h garantida)

title: Profissional Desenvolvedor .NET Pleno/Sênior
description:
Código da vaga: 51671


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


Ei #fera , chegou o momento de encarar um novo desafio em sua carreira! Venha ser um #ferabrq !


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia! É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!



O que você deve ter?


- Mais de 4 anos de experiência em .NET nas versões atuais;

- Experiência em AWS ( Ec2, S3, SNS, SQS, Lambdas);

- Experiência com microsserviços, padrões de projetos modernos, boas práticas de arquitetura dominando conceitos;

- Experiência com Programação orientada a objetos (POO);

- Atuar profissionalmente com filas de mensageria;

- Familiaridade com sistemas com muitas requisições e alta escalabilidade.


O que temos pra te oferecer?


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


As oportunidades são CLT com muitos benefícios, olha só:


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions .


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Brazilian Portuguese Teacher
description:
We're hiring! BORA Portuguese is looking for Brazilian Portuguese teachers.


BORA Portuguese is an online school that teaches real, spoken Brazilian Portuguese to English-speaking adults around the world. No textbook stiffness — we teach the way Brazilians actually talk, blending grammar, conversation, and cultural expressions into every lesson.


We're growing and looking for new teachers to join the team!


What you'll do:

→ Plan and deliver engaging online lessons

→ Provide meaningful feedback and track student progress

→ Build clear, empathetic, and culturally relevant connections with students


What we're looking for:

→ Fluent in Brazilian Portuguese (C2 level or equivalent)

→ Fluent or professional-level English

→ Experience teaching Portuguese to foreign/international students (1+ year preferred)

→ Strong communication skills and a student-centered approach

→ Knowledge of modern language teaching techniques that go beyond the textbook

→ Comfortable with online teaching tools

→ Flexible schedule (our students are in different time zones!)

→ A proper workspace with good lighting, camera, mic, and stable internet connection


Nice to have:

→ Degree in Letras or related field

→ PLE certification (Portuguese as a Foreign Language)


The role:

→ Independent contractor (freelance)

→ Fully remote — teach from wherever you are

→ Hours based on student demand

→ Structured materials and curriculum provided


If you're passionate about teaching Brazilian Portuguese and want to be part of a growing school with a lot of personality, we'd love to hear from you.


Send an email to with your CV and a short intro about yourself.

title: Senior Azure Architect
description:
Alyra Technology

Intelligent Systems for Mid-Market Enterprises

Contract • 5–15 hrs/week • Must be located in Brazil

Please submit resumes in English.


﻿

About Alyra Technology

Alyra Technology builds AI-enabled software and automation systems for mid-sized businesses, with a focus on document-heavy, regulated environments. We combine modern Azure cloud architecture with applied generative AI to deliver systems that are explainable, auditable, and production-ready — not demos. Our work centers on extracting structure, meaning, and decisions from complex, unstructured documents at scale.


The Role

We are looking for a senior Azure architect with deep, hands-on expertise in applied generative AI systems — specifically systems that work with unstructured text, complex documents, and regulated data. This is not a role for someone who has experimented with LLMs on the side or bolted GPT onto a web app. We need someone who has spent years designing production GenAI systems that deal with messy, real-world documents: contracts, filings, medical records, policies, financial statements.

This role is architecture-first. You will turn ambiguous AI ideas into clear, defensible system designs covering data flows, agent interactions, retrieval pipelines, security boundaries, and auditability strategies, primarily on Microsoft Azure.


What You’ll Do

Generative AI & Document Intelligence (Primary Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end GenAI systems for complex, unstructured document processing — including multi-format ingestion, layout-aware parsing, semantic chunking strategies, and document-grounded output generation.
  • Design retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines that handle real-world document complexity: scanned PDFs, inconsistent formatting, multi-section contracts, tables, and cross-document reasoning.
  • Define strategies for extracting structured data and decisions from unstructured text, including entity extraction, clause detection, classification hierarchies, and confidence-scored outputs.
  • Architect multi-agent systems that go beyond single-prompt workflows, including agent routing and specialization, tool use, evidence retrieval, citation strategies, and step-by-step auditability.
  • Design evaluation and regression frameworks for GenAI outputs, including ground-truth datasets, LLM-as-judge pipelines, and drift detection — so the system stays correct as models and data evolve.
  • Define prompt and behavior versioning strategies, human-in-the-loop review hooks, and hallucination mitigation patterns.


Azure Platform & Cloud Engineering

  • Design and validate usage of Azure AI services including Azure OpenAI Service, Azure AI Search (vector + hybrid), Azure Document Intelligence, Azure AI Foundry, and Azure Machine Learning.
  • Architect the broader platform stack: Azure Functions, App Services, Blob Storage and Data Lake, Azure SQL or Postgres, Entra ID, Key Vault, private endpoints, and networking boundaries.
  • Ensure all systems are observable, debuggable, and auditable by default — with logging, tracing, and cost instrumentation built in from day one.


Architecture & Design

  • Produce clear architecture diagrams — both logical and physical — covering ingestion pipelines, AI orchestration layers, storage and data lineage, security boundaries and RBAC, observability, and audit trails.
  • Make concrete tradeoffs around cost, latency, reliability, and explainability, and clearly explain those decisions to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Own ambiguous problems end-to-end and drive them to concrete, documented designs.


Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience designing and shipping production AI systems — not just evaluating or prototyping them.
  • 5+ years working directly with unstructured text: document parsing, information extraction, NLP pipelines, or document-centric AI applications. This is non-negotiable.
  • Proven experience building production-grade RAG systems, multi-agent architectures, or document intelligence pipelines that handle real-world complexity.
  • Deep Azure platform experience — designing real systems end to end, not just deploying managed services.
  • Strong understanding of how GenAI systems fail in production: hallucination, retrieval quality, context window limits, latency, and cost at scale.
  • Ability to design for auditability and explainability in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments.
  • Strong communication skills: able to convey complex AI architecture through diagrams and written documentation for both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • 7+ years of total software or platform engineering experience.


Strongly Preferred

  • Hands-on experience with complex, multi-page document types: contracts, legal filings, medical records, financial statements, insurance forms, or regulatory submissions.
  • Experience with layout-aware document parsing tools (e.g., Azure Document Intelligence, Unstructured, LayoutLM, or similar) and the architectural decisions around pre-processing pipelines.
  • Experience designing document-grounded output systems where every AI response is traceable to specific source passages or pages.
  • Prior consulting or client-facing architecture experience in a regulated domain such as insurance, legal, finance, or healthcare.
  • Familiarity with Azure AI Foundry as part of a broader workflow stack.
  • Comfort working alongside AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code.


Values & Working Style

  • Hardworking and dependable: you do what you say you’ll do, and you finish.
  • Ownership mindset: you take problems end-to-end and don’t wait to be told.
  • High standards: you care about correctness, security, and maintainability.
  • Clear communication: you surface risks early and ask the right questions when requirements are ambiguous.
  • Practical builder: you avoid over-engineering and ship what matters.

title: Subject Matter Expert – Chartered & Certified Accountants (Remote)
description:
Start Date: Ongoing

Screener Criteria: Active professional certification (CPA, ACCA, ACA, etc.)

Eligible Locations:

Language Requirement: Fluent English

Type of contract: Freelance / On-Call Advisory

Hourly Rate: $60.00

Minimum Hours: No minimum

Maximum Hours: Ad hoc / Subject to project availability


About Prolific

Prolific is not just another player in the AI space. We are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.

Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organisations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.


The Opportunity

We are inviting Certified Accountants to join our global network of Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). This is not a traditional accounting role; instead, you will be providing expert-level analysis for B2B and AI Research projects that require a deep understanding of fiscal regulations, reporting standards, and financial logic.

Please note: This is a \"bench\" model. By verifying your credentials, you gain eligibility for high-level research tasks as they become available. Access is based on project demand and professional profile matching.


What you’ll be doing

When selected for an active project, your tasks will involve:

  • Professional document analysis: Reviewing complex financial statements, audit reports, and regulatory filings to ensure data integrity.
  • Domain-specific validation: Answering knowledge-based questions that require an active understanding of international or local accounting standards.
  • Business logic synthesis: Providing the professional \"human-in-the-loop\" oversight that ensures B2B research is accurate and enterprise-ready.


What you’ll bring

  • Active certification: You must hold a valid, verifiable professional license (e.g., CPA, ACCA, ACA, CIMA, or regional equivalent).
  • Technical rigor: The ability to navigate long-form financial documents and extract precise information under research conditions.
  • Global perspective: We welcome qualified accountants from around the world who can apply their local or international standards to complex datasets.
  • Integrity: All participants must undergo a verification process to confirm their active professional standing.


Why join this project?

This is a flexible, high-rate opportunity to apply your specialised certification to the forefront of global business research. At $60 per hour , you can contribute your expertise on an ad hoc basis that fits perfectly around your existing clients or firm commitments.


Why Prolific is a great platform to join as an expert participant

Joining our platform as a participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.


We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioral data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.


We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviors into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.

Privacy Statement

By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organization planning. Prolific's Candidate Privacy Notice explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific's use of your personal information.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description:

What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.


Day to day, you'll be working on things like:

  • Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript
  • Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals
  • Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs
  • Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications
  • Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions

You should have:

  • 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this)

  • Backend capability with Node.js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer
  • Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors
  • Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcome


Nice to have:

  • Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms

  • Experience leading or mentoring other engineers
  • Apple Pay integration experience


Why FlyMeOut:

  • Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension
  • Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026
  • Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones
  • Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product
  • Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up
  • Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction


Compensation & Terms

This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise.

Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month)

Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible)

Health benefits: Not offered at this stage

Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis

Probation: 2 weeks

Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM Brasil


How to Apply

Send your resume to with the subject line FMO-RN-2026 . In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

description:
Título da posição: Data Analyst V BRL

Tipo de contratação: Temporário via agência

Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está em busca de um(a) Analista de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de performance do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de análises avançadas. A equipe atua em parceria próxima com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders de negócio para mensurar o desempenho das nossas ofertas aos clientes, gerar insights sobre o comportamento dos clientes e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.


O(a) Analista de Dados desempenhará um papel crítico na transformação de dados complexos em insights acionáveis, no desenvolvimento de frameworks analíticos e na viabilização do monitoramento de performance por meio de dashboards, relatórios e análises aprofundadas. Esta função exige forte rigor analítico, visão de negócio e capacidade de comunicar insights de forma clara para stakeholders seniores.


O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui histórico comprovado de entrega de análises de alto impacto em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, além de estar confortável equilibrando análises estruturadas e recorrentes com demandas ad hoc que apoiam prioridades de negócio em constante evolução.


O que você fará

  • Aplicar forte mentalidade analítica e de resolução de problemas para identificar questões de negócio, lacunas de performance e oportunidades de melhoria, traduzindo-as em abordagens analíticas claras.
  • Apoiar iniciativas de BMP fornecendo insights sobre performance do negócio, eficiência operacional, direcionadores financeiros e KPIs estratégicos.
  • Projetar, desenvolver e manter dashboards, relatórios e modelos analíticos para acompanhar a performance em relação às metas e apoiar a tomada de decisão da liderança.
  • Conduzir análises ad hoc e aprofundadas para explicar tendências, variações, riscos e oportunidades, além de avaliar o impacto de iniciativas de negócio.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com stakeholders para entender objetivos, definir métricas relevantes e garantir que as entregas analíticas estejam alinhadas às necessidades de decisão.
  • Atuar em parceria com as equipes de engenharia de dados, finanças e outros times de analytics para garantir qualidade, consistência e escalabilidade das soluções de reporte.
  • Sintetizar análises complexas em narrativas claras e objetivas, apresentando resultados que traduzam dados em insights acionáveis para a liderança sênior.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de frameworks analíticos, ferramentas e melhores práticas dentro da equipe de BMP Analytics.


Qualificações Mínimas

  • Mestrado em Analytics, Ciência de Dados, Economia, Estatística, Engenharia, Administração ou área quantitativa relacionada.
  • Mais de 5 anos de experiência em análise de dados, analytics de negócio ou gestão de performance.
  • Experiência sólida com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação analítica (Python ou equivalente).
  • Experiência na construção de dashboards e relatórios utilizando ferramentas de BI (preferencialmente Power BI).
  • Forte pensamento analítico, com capacidade comprovada de estruturar problemas ambíguos.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e apresentação, com capacidade de engajar públicos técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de colaboração eficaz em equipes multifuncionais.
  • Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

  • Experiência com análises financeiras ou de gestão de performance de negócios.
  • Familiaridade com técnicas analíticas avançadas (previsão, análise estatística, modelagem de cenários).
  • Experiência com ambientes de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS).
  • Experiência com pipelines de dados, automação ou ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow).
  • Experiência com big data ou frameworks de processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).
  • Experiência em organização global matricial.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
UI/UX Designer

Full-Time | Brazil (Hybrid) | Mid–Senior Level


About the Role

We build technology products for companies that are reshaping how industries operate. Our design team sits at the intersection of product strategy, engineering, and user research, and the work we do ships to real users.


This is not a purely visual design role. Designers here influence product direction, collaborate closely with engineers and product leaders, and help define how complex systems should actually work.


We are looking for a UI/UX Designer who can move fluidly between ambiguous discovery work and pixel-precise execution. You will partner with product managers, engineers, and client stakeholders to design experiences that are strategically sound and deeply usable.


What You'll Do

• Own design end-to-end for one or more product workstreams, from research and wireframes through final developer handoff

• Facilitate discovery sessions with clients and internal teams to clarify problems before jumping into solutions

• Produce high-fidelity prototypes and detailed design specifications that engineers can build from with minimal iteration

• Conduct usability testing and translate insights into actionable design improvements

title: Clinical Trial Associate II
description:
Clinical Trial Associate II


Resumo da Posição

O Clinical Trial Associate II desempenha um papel fundamental de suporte no planejamento, execução e encerramento de estudos clínicos nacionais e internacionais, com crescente autonomia e independência operacional. Com base em experiências prévias em operações de estudos clínicos, espera-se que o CTA II gerencie proativamente a documentação e os processos principais, identifique e resolva desafios operacionais, e atue como um ponto de coordenação confiável entre as equipes de estudo, fornecedores e centros de pesquisa. Este cargo também contribui para melhorias de processos e apoia a equipe na preparação para auditorias e inspeções.


Principais Responsabilidades:

• Fornecer suporte operacional para a execução bem-sucedida dos estudos clínicos, do desenvolvimento do protocolo até o encerramento do estudo, em conformidade com as Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e normas regulatórias internacionais.

• Gerenciar de forma independente os controles dos estudos clínicos, incluindo acompanhamento de documentos regulatórios, progresso de start-up, métricas de recrutamento, registros de faturas/pagamentos e desempenho de fornecedores, assegurando precisão, consistência e atualizações em tempo hábil.

• Coordenar reuniões de estudos clínicos (internas e externas), incluindo preparação de agendas, logística dos encontros e atas detalhadas com ações de acompanhamento.

• Apoiar a supervisão de fornecedores e CROs, acompanhando entregas, identificando lacunas ou riscos e comunicando-os preventivamente aos Clinical Trial Managers (CTMs).

• Auxiliar na preparação e submissão de documentos para Comitês de Ética/Comissões de Ética (IRB/EC) e para órgãos regulatórios, com papel ampliado na gestão de prazos e controle de qualidade.

• Realizar revisões contínuas do Trial Master File (TMF) e reconciliações; liderar atividades de controle de qualidade de documentos com supervisão mínima e contribuir ativamente para o planejamento de prontidão para inspeções.

• Coordenar e acompanhar a logística de equipamentos e suprimentos dos estudos clínicos junto a fornecedores e centros.

• Colaborar com CTMs e demais áreas para promover melhorias contínuas de processos e contribuir para atualizações de Procedimentos Operacionais Padrão (SOP) e instruções de trabalho.

• Assumir responsabilidade por projetos especiais e iniciativas transversais que exijam iniciativa, pensamento analítico e discernimento para resolver problemas.


Qualificações

• Graduação preferencialmente nas áreas de Ciências Biológicas ou Saúde.

• Inglês Fluente

• Conhecimento prático demonstrado das diretrizes ICH-GCP e normas regulatórias aplicáveis; experiência prévia no suporte a TMF, CTMS e atividades de controle de qualidade documental é obrigatória.

• Fortes habilidades interpessoais e de comunicação escrita; confortável em interagir com áreas como Garantia da Qualidade, Gerenciamento de Dados, Bioestatística, Segurança e Suprimentos Clínicos.

• Capacidade de antecipar as necessidades da equipe, tomar iniciativa e propor soluções em um ambiente dinâmico.

• Confortável em lidar com dados sensíveis, exercendo discrição adequada.

title: Tech Lead Salesforce Developer
description:
Tech Lead Salesforce Developer


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

title: ANALISTA DE SISTEMAS SR [ANALYTICS ENGINEER - DATABRICKS]
description:
O Grupo Petrópolis é a única grande empresa do setor cervejeiro com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com os rótulos Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévis, as vodkas Blue Spirit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It!, o isotônico TNT Sports Drink e a água Petra.


Com oito fábricas em operação e aproximadamente 160 centros de distribuição, o grupo é responsável pela geração de aproximadamente 22 mil empregos diretos. Por meio dos projetos ambientais, promove o plantio e manutenção de milhares de árvores, além de ações de sustentabilidade e programa de educação ambiental para escolas municipais. Conta também com o Saber Beber, programa comprometido em orientar as pessoas sobre os benefícios do consumo moderado e as consequências do consumo exagerado de álcool.


O respeito é um dos valores do Grupo Petrópolis, e por isso todas as crenças, identidades culturais, gêneros, idades, raças, opções individuais e pessoas com deficiência são respeitadas e valorizadas. Para todas as nossas vagas consideramos candidatos representados por esta ampla diversidade.



Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos buscando uma pessoa com energia, senso de dono e muita vontade de construir para atuar como protagonista na evolução do nosso ecossistema moderno de dados.

Essa posição terá papel fundamental na consolidação e evolução da arquitetura analítica baseada em Databricks e Microsoft Fabric, garantindo integração eficiente entre engenharia, modelagem e consumo estratégico de dados.

Se você gosta de transformar ambientes complexos em soluções organizadas, escaláveis e orientadas a negócio, essa oportunidade é para você.

· Desenvolver e manter pipelines de dados no Databricks, garantindo performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade.

· Integrar múltiplas fontes de dados (Oracle, SQL Server e outras).

· Atuar próximo às áreas de negócio, traduzindo demandas em soluções escaláveis.

· Propor melhorias contínuas na arquitetura e processos de dados.

· Experiência com Microsoft Fabric (Lakehouse, pipelines, integração, modelagem, DAX, performance).
